sources.entry: Cacti | Network monitoring and graphing tool

summary.one_liner: Cacti is an open-source network monitoring and graphing platform built on RRDtool that collects, stores, and visualizes time-series data from network devices, servers, and applications.
summary.what_it_does: Cacti provides automated device discovery and local or remote data collection, with graph, data source, and RRA templating. It polls devices via SNMP (v1/v2/v3, with IPv6 support) and also supports scripts, command output, databases, and custom input methods. Data is collected by either the built-in PHP poller or the C-based Spine poller. Graphing uses RRDtool, with dynamic graph viewing (time navigation, realtime view, CSV export) and broad RRDtool features such as VDEFs and stacked lines. Access is controlled with role-based access control (RBAC) and a plugin framework supports extensions.
use_cases: monitor network device traffic and bandwidth
poll SNMP devices and graph metrics over time
how_to_run: Configure the database and web server, then complete setup using the official docs
notable: Built on RRDtool with templating for graphs, data sources, and RRAs
Two pollers: built-in PHP poller and high-performance Spine
Plugin framework and RBAC for per-user and group permissions
Release archives include checksum, CycloneDX SBOM, and provenance attestation
caveats: Source checkouts require Composer and Node.js builds; a web server with PHP and a MariaDB/MySQL database are required
The README's performance notes come from synthetic data and do not measure live SNMP or production capacity
The develop branch (1.3.x) has higher minimum dependency versions than 1.2.x
